links.outcome: Reproducibility of mapped treatment categories across three runs with identical inputs
links.effect: Non-identical mapped categories across three runs occurred in 12/50 preoperative and 8/50 postoperative assessments despite identical inputs.
links.quote: Non-identical mapped categories across three runs occurred in 12/50 preoperative and 8/50 postoperative assessments despite identical inputs.

links.outcome: LLM concordance with MDT compared against majority-class baseline
links.effect: Preoperatively the LLM had the same crude concordance as the majority-class baseline but higher κ and balanced category-specific concordance; postoperatively it exceeded the baseline across these metrics.
links.quote: Compared with the majority-class baseline, the LLM had the same preoperative crude concordance but higher κ and balanced category-specific concordance; postoperatively, it exceeded the majority-class baseline across these metrics.

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating LLM concordance with multidisciplinary team clinical decisions for rectal cancer treatment pathways without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
